setup.command: cd backend && (test -d venv || python3 -m venv venv) && ./venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt pytest && cd ../frontend && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

run.command: cd backend && (./venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 54321 &) && cd ../frontend && npm run dev:web -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173

check.command: cd backend && ./venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -p no:warnings && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck:web
